reviews.review: Love this game. It has a nice difficulty curve, but is still punishingly difficult in the later levels. There are ten or so classes and every single one of them requires you to adapt your playstyle to work to that character's strengths. There's a great mix of randomness and predictability and skill to each game you play that keeps the game fun even after 20 hours. And with a little help from google, the archaic online co-op system is easy enough to figure out. I've had nights where me and three other friends have set up our computers in one person's kitchen and we've played for hours. I seriously recommend this rougelike to anyone who likes a challenge.

If metal slug and gauntlet had a baby they would name it risk of rain...

Probably the best Rogue-Like Permadeath game I have ever played. The game's simple visuals and gameplay are extremely appealing, and easy to get into. The class and item variety make the game have near endless replay value, as well as providing a new, different experience every time you play. With that being said, this game is not easy. You need to have an excessive amount of items to stand a chance, especially if you plan on beating the game. The last level becomes insane, and the last boss is a challenge in himself.

10/10 A near flawless game that captivates time and time again.
